proposal_title: Deletion of GenerationJob.track_mode from Canonical Domain Schema
domain_specific_rationale: From a Contracts Architecture and DDD perspective, CP-016 formally ratifies the deletion of track_mode from the canonical GenerationJob entity schema in domain-entities.schema.json. The execution track (e.g. Track A Playwright vs Track A Extension vs Track B FlowKit) is an operational worker dispatch concern, not an intrinsic domain entity attribute. Embedding worker dispatch modes inside canonical domain entities creates leaky abstractions and schema coupling. Removing track_mode restores contract purity and adheres to clean architecture principles.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-18 (Track A / Track B Port Equivalence).
residual_risk: Legacy services attempting to persist track_mode will fail JSON schema validation under additionalProperties: false. Mitigated by updating all client contracts and integration test fixtures.
